serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.sad You: We somehow made it… Bot: What about my arm? You: Try to hide it somewhere. Bot: I have no vision. I can only operate based on its last known coordinates. You: Do your best! All we can do now is eavesdrop on them through the door… Policeman: So, old man. You called us again because of some ghosts? Someone just flipped your breaker, that’s all. Old Man: N-No, there were messages on the screen and a dark figure telling me: ‘your time has come’... {f_botName} went a little overboard… Policewoman: Maybe you should’ve called paramedics instead, it seems like you are going crazy. Old Man: I’m not crazy! There was a severed arm! A severed arm was chasing me in this very corridor! Policeman: Alright, old timer. We will look around. Policewoman: Seriously? Policeman: What? I want to see an animated severed arm! Policewoman: Whatever. Make it quick. Bot: Not good. The chances of them finding it are around 80%! You: Nothing we can do now, let’s hope for the best… Policewoman: Did you find anything? Policeman: {{punch}}OH MY GOD! IT’S HERE! Policewoman: For real? I swear, if this is a joke… #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.angry Bot: Not good! I need to move! Policeman: It’s charging at me! Help! Policeman: Hands up! Hands up or I will shoot! Old Man: Agh!!! {{punch}} Policewoman: Just fucking shoot it, idiot! #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.veryshock
